meta.purpose: Tier A civil festival dates (Jagannath / Puri cycle and Odia-specific days) with citations. Human-maintained: add a row only with a source you have read. Never generate from the engine or from Drik (Drik is the separate Tier B reference in festival_reference/).
meta.tiers: A1 = Odisha Tourism / Shree Jagannath Temple Administration; A2 = Wikipedia Ratha Yatra (Puri) table; A3 = dated news / temple event listing for that year
meta.maintenance: Each year, before Snana Purnima: add Snana / Rath / Hera / Bahuda (and Suna Besha, Niladri Bije when published) from the temple or Tourism schedule. tests/test_festival_dates.py fails when a seeded year within the look-ahead window has no Tier A Rath row. Each January, add the Odisha Government holiday list for the year (A1) — it is the civil authority for Odia festival days.
